subject.title: improve(ui): restyle composer send button as filled accent circle

question: Should the current main composer adopt this filled 36px accent-circle send control instead of its newer compact transparent 30px control?
rationale: Both implementations can be technically valid; choosing the intended Control UI visual hierarchy, size, and variant treatment requires the Control UI owner's design judgment.

options.title: Adopt Filled Accent
options.body: Rebase the patch onto current main and preserve the filled primary-action treatment with refreshed visual proof.

options.title: Keep Compact Control
options.body: Retain current main's smaller muted control and close this visual direction without merging the branch.

options.title: Request Hybrid Styling
options.body: Keep the arrow-up glyph but ask for revised size, fill, or state styling that fits the newer composer design.

recommendation.title: Adopt Filled Accent
recommendation.body: Rebase the patch onto current main and preserve the filled primary-action treatment with refreshed visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository-documented Control UI owner and the clearest decision-maker for composer visual hierarchy.
